name: What types of windows are best for preventing drafts?

mainEntity.name: What types of windows are best for preventing drafts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Windows designed for energy efficiency are best for preventing drafts. This often includes double-pane or triple-pane windows with low-emissivity (Low-E) coatings and argon or krypton gas fills between the panes. These features reduce heat transfer and improve insulation. High-quality frames made from materials like vinyl, fiberglass, or wood also contribute to a tight seal and minimize air infiltration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Energy-efficient windows like double or triple-pane with Low-E coatings and gas fills are best for draft prevention.
